name: Setup Docker Compose Testing Environment (Simplified)
description: Simplified Docker Compose setup that assumes services may already be running and focuses on health validation

task_steps.description: Check Docker environment and start/restart services as needed

prompt.template:
Set up the Docker Compose testing environment:

1. Verify Docker and Docker Compose are installed:
   - Run: docker --version
   - Run: docker-compose --version

2. Check current service status:
   - Run: docker-compose ps
   - Note which services are already running

3. Start backend services (stable profile):
   - Run: docker-compose --profile stable up -d
   - This starts: redis, surreal, surrealist, metabob-rpc-api-server
   - Services already running will not be recreated

4. Start devbob container:
   {{#if useDevProfile}}
   - Run: docker-compose --profile stable --profile devbob-dev up -d
   {{else}}
   - Run: docker-compose --profile stable --profile devbob up -d
   {{/if}}

5. Wait for services to initialize:
   - Wait 10 seconds
   - Run: docker-compose ps

Provide a summary:
- ✅ Services started (new or already running)
- 📊 Container status
- ⏱️  Initialization complete

variables.name: useDevProfile
variables.description: Use devbob-dev profile instead of clean devbob

task_steps.description: Verify all services are healthy and accessible

prompt.template:
Run comprehensive health checks:

1. Check container status:
   - Run: docker-compose ps
   - Verify expected containers are running

2. Test backend services:
   - Redis: docker-compose exec -T redis redis-cli ping
   - SurrealDB: curl -sf http://localhost:8000/health
   - API Server: curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health

3. Test devbob container:
   - Check container health: docker ps --filter name=devbob-clean --format "{{{{.Status}}}}"
   - Note: ACP server may take 30+ seconds to start

4. Check resource usage:
   - Run: docker stats --no-stream --format "table {{{{.Container}}}}\t{{{{.CPUPerc}}}}\t{{{{.MemUsage}}}}"

5. Check for errors:
   - Run: docker-compose logs --since=2m --tail=20

Provide comprehensive report:
- ✅ All services healthy
- ✅ Health endpoints accessible
- 📊 Resource usage normal
- 🚀 Environment ready for testing
- ⚠️  Any warnings or issues
